messages:
maria: Hey team — ACME POC failing, 403 on /v1/generate with the trial key. Demo in ~2h, can someone triage?

maria: Here is the failing curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_abc123' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

maria: Response body: {"error":"Forbidden","message":"org mismatch: token org=org_789, request org=org_456" }

devon: ugh, org mismatch — likely the trial key is bound to their sandbox org (org_789) but the demo code sets X-Redwood-Org: org_456. Can you confirm which org the customer is passing?

maria: customer says they set the header to their project org_456 via env var. They pasted their app config earlier but maybe env var stale.

ravi: quick checks:
- verify Authorization token (keys are org-bound). do `echo sk_trial_abc123 | jq -R -r @base64` not great — easier: paste token into jwt.io to inspect `org` claim.
- server-side libs usually override header; confirm if frontend is adding X-Redwood-Org.

ravi: if token org != expected org, two options: rotate key under the correct org or remove X-Redwood-Org header for unscoped requests (not ideal for prod).

sophie: short-term workaround: create a temporary demo key attached to org_456 and send to ACME. I'll create one and flag it as demo-only. maria, confirm you want that? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: yes please, demo at 3pm. Also CS asked whether we need to charge for extended trial if they ask for extra quota. Any pricing notes?

devon: for hands-on demos we can extend trial for 48-72h without charging — coordinate with AM if >72h. I'll note in CRM.

sophie: creating demo key now...

deploy-bot: [key.created] key id: sk_demo_zz9xx bound_org: org_456 created_by: sophie

maria: got it, forwarding sk_demo_zz9xx to customer. also flagged docs about org header and token binding to send after demo.

ravi: one more tip for team: if customers see intermittent 403s, check for load balancer or proxy rewriting headers — that commonly breaks X-Redwood-Org.

maria: thanks all — keeping this thread open. I'll post back after demo with outcome. :white_check_mark:
